findings.text: The no-added-failure arm covers 14 of the 38 test modules that import a changed module, so the modules covering mast_geometry, mast_vacuum_cohort and the remaining mast_* consumers were never measured; the omission is recorded honestly, and the defaults are pinned unchanged, but a failure introduced in those consumers would not have been seen.

No assertion in tests/test_filepath_data_roots.py covers this route or the one in nova/imas/connect.py:117, so restoring either literal leaves the suite green; the negative control proves only the product-constant assertions fire.

The new _named_root helper restates the environment-override idiom that operand_cache_root at :35-38 already carries in the same file, leaving two spellings of one rule where the owner could hold one.

The recorded provenance string changes from the portable ~/.cache/nova-mast/... form to an absolute per-user home path, so a written recorded_corrections document now embeds the running user's home directory where it previously embedded a tilde.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Runtime consumers of the changed constants were opened and read: catalog geometry default arguments, the MAST chain factory, flux-loop adjudication, mast_efit, diiid_current, sweep merge_chunks and Connect.rsync.
item_verdicts.diff: Four commits read against 0f50140bb: named roots added to filepath.py, 10 product modules switched to them, two dead literals deleted, a Path-to-text fix in sweep.py, and a new 170-line test.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for a quoted grep over nova/, a new test failing at base and passing at head, and no added failure across the importing modules; the first two hold and the third holds over a 14-of-38 subset.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to route every hard-coded GPFS and home data path in nova/ through the existing FilePath owner; the diff does that for all 12 named sites and deletes two dead literals.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest records status complete, four commits, the arm-pair exit statuses (base EXIT=4, head EXIT=1) and the recorded shortfall of the full importer set.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared write paths list 16 entries; every path in the diff against 0f50140bb is inside that list, with no write outside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_filepath_data_roots.py:79 and :164 assert each accessor and nine product constants against independent literals, and the negative control reddens two assertions, but no assertion covers the sweep.py:655 or connect.py:117 route.
justifications.evidence: The new test fails at base (AttributeError: module 'nova.database.filepath' has no attribute 'mast_level1_shots', gate-fast-base.log) and head passes it, but the suite gate ran 14 of the 38 declared importer modules (docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-gpfs-data-root.html:31).
justifications.fit: The module-level accessors with docstring-cited defaults follow the existing operand_cache_root idiom at nova/database/filepath.py:35-38, though the new import lands out of alphabetical order at nova/imas/diiid_current.py:17-21.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every site the brief names now reads a named root from nova/database/filepath.py:41-124, and an independent grep at 60aa92783 over nova/ for /work/projects, /home/ITER and ~/ returns hits only in filepath.py plus three solve_request.py docstrings.
justifications.reuse: The change extends the owner of this capability rather than forking it, but _named_root at nova/database/filepath.py:78 restates the override idiom that operand_cache_root at :35-38 already holds instead of folding it in.
justifications.scope_discipline: All 15 changed paths sit inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the two deletions (VACUUM_COHORT_STORE, qsub) are literals the brief licensed removing.
